designer-initial.summary: Selected a finite preparation-qualified EIT monitoring and impedance-acquisition coordinator with an audited 8/21/20/7 medium-tier design.
questions_for_model: Can the eight semantic owners and their pre-state feedback be realized in the permitted SysML-AADL subset without a combinational ownership cycle, and what exact generated containment support is required if not?

Can EligibilityEnvelope and MonitoringDecisionSnapshot be modeled as finite typed data whose owner-local contracts exclude illegal field combinations without weakening end-to-end guarantees through assumptions?
Can the preparation and monitoring transition partitions preserve sole state ownership and explicit branch priority while remaining analyzable over all 10,368 raw input/pre-state combinations?
If containment delegation adds raw usages or connection declarations, what exact raw metrics result while the frozen semantic counts remain 8 usages and 21 interactions?

model-review.summary: Realizable after making PART-01 nonidentity and fixing local containment, record, and trace mappings.

findings.evidence: PART-01 maps the three BeltObservation values bijectively to BELT_UNAVAILABLE, BELT_ABSENT, and BELT_PRESENT; each output is only the corresponding input category under a new label, so the claimed many-to-one qualification is an identity wrapper under M-17.
findings.requested_change: Change PART-01 to output a BeltAssessment record whose reason/category preserves the three distinctions and whose owner-local qualified Boolean is false for invalid/not-applied and true only for applied; change INT-07 and INT-08 to carry that record, make PART-02 and PART-03 consume the Boolean without recomputation, and preserve the semantic 8/21/20/7 tuple and all domain behavior.

findings.evidence: Trusted System-to-Process-to-Thread syntax and current well-formed stateful models support one behavior-free Process containing the eight Threads. Six root inputs plus three root outputs require nine support routes; with 21 Process-local semantic connections this yields 9 non-root usages, depth 2, and 30 raw PortConnection declarations.
findings.requested_change: Select one uncredited generated-support Process and nine tagged support routes; record raw counts of 9 reachable non-root usages and 30 source connections while retaining exactly 8 semantic usages and 21 semantic interactions.

findings.evidence: The trusted/current subset supports Data attributes, local state, In(state), and field-wise record guarantees, but current GUMBO repair evidence reports feature-redeclaration failures when enum classifiers are reused across inspected Data attributes; TYPE-10 through TYPE-14 repeatedly project PreparationState, MonitoringState, EffectiveIntent, RequestDisposition, and SessionNotice.
findings.requested_change: Use attribute members and field-specific enum classifiers for every repeated record projection, with extensionally identical literals and explicit zero owner/semantic/case credit; retain canonical governor state types and preserve all relations.

findings.evidence: Q-MODEL-02 says EligibilityEnvelope is carried on INT-12, INT-14, and INT-16, but the authoritative interaction inventory assigns EligibilityEnvelope only to INT-12 and INT-16 and assigns PreparationDecisionSnapshot to INT-14.
findings.requested_change: Correct Q-MODEL-02 to name INT-12 and INT-16 for EligibilityEnvelope and INT-14 for PreparationDecisionSnapshot; do not change the 21-interaction topology.

findings.evidence: PART-02 through PART-08 each have a substantive many-to-one, multi-input, priority, state-dependent, or admission relation; copied state/status fields and one-to-one frame labels are explicitly uncredited. State feedback, structured records, cases 17/18, and exhaustive analysis of 10,368 valuations are supported by retained current patterns and the checker watchdog.
